meta.title: The Secret Service Agency
meta.author: H0ffman (H0ffman, Ivory Labs, Quadtrip)
meta.description: The soundtrack of The Secret Service Agency by H0ffman, Ivory Labs, Quadtrip (2019-04-20). A 64K intro that placed 9th in the PC 64K intro competition at Revision 2019. Music credited to H0ffman on Demozoo. 135 BPM, 3:44, 37 tracks, 3590 notes. Instruments: 5 Falcon (FM synth), 7 Slaughter (subtractive synth), 13 Adultery (GM.DLS sampler), 6 Specimen (GSM sampler). Effects: 7 Scissor, 18 Leveller, 7 Crusher, 7 Echo, 16 Smasher, 3 Twister, 18 Cathedral. Its Adultery instruments play waves from the Windows GM.DLS bank: they sound as intended only with that bank (GM_DLS=<path to gm.dls>); macOS's own GS bank has other waves. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: the WaveSabre song was read from the running executable's memory (tools/ws-extract, Wine), converted by `synth-convert ws` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64, effects 65-73) and imported with `song import` (lanes cut into 2-, 4- or 8-bar patterns, notes rounded to 960 ticks per beat). Against the bit-exact WaveSabre port it differs by +0.11 dB loudness and at most 0.60 dB in any octave band from 63 Hz to 8 kHz (16 kHz up to 3 dB brighter, a known difference of the unified engine). Track names are derived here from each track's instrument and notes; the executable does not store the authors' names. No licence is stated: the music belongs to its authors. It is published here as an adapted reference copy while its authors are asked for permission, and is removed at any author's request.
